column1: # One row per platform a release ships; the one list that mk/release.mk,
# Columns are separated by a TAB. The first non-comment row names the columns.
#   slug    the name of the platform (npm spells it the same way)
#   runner  the GitHub Actions runner that builds it, natively (no cross build)
#   capi    the C ABI library: the name cargo gives it, which every SDK looks for
#   gem     the RubyGems platform of the platform gem
#   wheel   the platform tag of the wheel (manylinux_2_36: built on bookworm, glibc 2.36)
#   jna     the directory JNA looks in under native/ (Java)
#   npm     the npm package of the Node.js addon
